name: Omiloxetine
summary: Omiloxetine (omiloextinum, omiloxetino INN) was a selective serotonin reuptake inhibitor drug candidate that underwent preclinical development by the Spanish pharmaceutical company, Ferrer Internacional, until 2005, when it was abandoned.

pharmacology.text: Omiloxetine (omiloextinum, omiloxetino INN) was a selective serotonin reuptake inhibitor drug candidate that underwent preclinical development by the Spanish pharmaceutical company, Ferrer Internacional, until 2005, when it was abandoned.

uses.en: It was a drug candidate for depression and never reached use.
uses.zh: 它曾是憂鬱症的候選藥物，從未實際使用。
uses.zhHans: 它曾是忧郁症的候选药物，从未实际使用。

fact.en: It was developed by the Spanish company Ferrer International and never got past preclinical testing, which is the fate of most drug candidates.
fact.zh: 它由西班牙法爾瑪公司（Ferrer International）研發，始終未能通過臨床前試驗階段，而這也是大多數候選藥物的命運。
fact.zhHans: 它由西班牙法尔玛公司（Ferrer International）研发，始终未能通过临床前试验阶段，而这也是大多数候选药物的命运。
